claims.claim_text: A 911 call reported a male subject brandishing a firearm at a reporting party in a vehicle
The suspect was traveling in a gray Toyota sedan
The suspect was last seen pulling into the 7-Eleven parking lot at Beach Boulevard and Lincoln Avenue
At approximately 1619 hours, APD Officer Dahl arrived at the 7-Eleven
A male matching the suspect description was walking on Lincoln Avenue just north of the parking lot
The subject, later identified as Diego Renteria, immediately fled southbound on foot upon seeing Officer Dahl
The subject entered the Walmart parking lot
Officer Dahl broadcast a description of the subject: a Hispanic male with a shaved head, wearing a black jacket with white stripes on the sleeves and black shorts
At approximately 1629 hours, Officer T. Ross and Officer A. Gutierrez observed the subject walking eastbound on Adams Way near Grand Avenue
Upon seeing the officers, the subject fled on foot and jumped a wall into the yard of a residence at 7944 Adams Way
The APD helicopter "Angel" responded and began establishing an aerial perimeter
claims.evidence_observations: The text at 1:46 states 'video footage are made public and published on the Orange County District Attorney's website' and the text at 1:10 states 'The video is from Anaheim PD Helicopter Angel'. The helicopter footage shown is from a police helicopter, consistent with the claim.

claims.claim_text: Additional units set up a ground perimeter

claims.claim_text: At approximately 1656 hours, APD Sgt. J. Harmon distributed a wanted flyer identifying the subject as Renteria
The subject was wanted by the Buena Park Police Department in connection with a residential burglary in which a firearm was stolen
The flyer cautioned that the subject should be considered armed and dangerous
Officer Montoya and I were assigned to maintain a perimeter position in the backyard of 7914 Adams, approximately three houses east of 7896 Adams
Beginning at approximately 1700 hours, officers within the helicopter made repeated public address announcements in English and Spanish
The subject was directed to exit the residence at 7896 Adams with his hands raised
The subject was observed through the windows walking up and down the stairs but made no effort to comply
At approximately 1737 hours, I observed the subject exit from the front door of 7896 Adams
claims.evidence_observations: At approximately 17:37 (video timestamp), the subject exits the front door of the residence and walks toward the officers' position in the backyard.
